sn8.5:2.1: While this sounds like a standard teaching, it is only found in this context. A different set of five factors is at [an5.198]().
sn8.5:7.1: The truth is undying because the principles of the Dhamma are always true ([sn12.20:2.3]()).
sn8.5:7.2: “Undying speech” (_amṛtā vāco_) is indeed found in Vedic context (eg. Jaimini Gṛhyasūtra 2.1, Brahma Purāṇa 219.58), where it means speech that is immortal since it is of the Divine.
